0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The Eulmoran soldier requires some assistance in his endeavor to raise the spirits of his city's people.

24.original: Take notes on Eulmorans' food preferences.

25.original: Report to the Eulmoran soldier at the Eulmoran Army Headquarters.

48.original: Haven't we met somewh─ Oh, it's you! I saw you fight! You were so strong, so confident, but so careful not to injure any of the civilians...

49.original: Maybe you'd be interested in helping out with what I'm planning. I'm a fairly decent cook, actually─I sometimes feel as if that's the <hex:021A020203>only<hex:021A020103> thing I'm good at─and I thought it might bring people comfort to know that they could come here and get a decent meal.

50.original: The trouble is, there are too many options as to what I could prepare, and I'm not much for making decisions. I would simply ask around, but civilians tend to get a bit nervous when a member of the army starts asking questions, and I don't want to cause anyone <hex:021A020203>more<hex:021A020103> distress.

51.original: That being the case─would you mind asking a few people what sort of dishes might lift their spirits? I don't need the recipes, just ideas.

52.original: Food that would lift my spirits? Hmm... Voeburt muffins, maybe? My mother often used to make them.

53.original: Free meals? Yes, that would certainly improve the mood around here. As for what people would enjoy─perhaps a dish that they've never had before? Though I'm not terribly familiar with anything other than Voeburtite cuisine, myself.

54.original: How about Kholusian stew? It was a popular dish before the Flood, apparently. All I really know is that it's meant to incorporate a variety of seafood, but I've always wanted to try it─seems a shame that I've never had the traditional food of my homeland.

55.original: The smell of baking muffins is absolutely divine, I assure you!

56.original: Perhaps someone who wasn't born locally might have more ideas...

57.original: I don't know about you, but reviving the popularity of Kholusian stew and reclaiming our heritage would certainly raise <hex:021A020203>my<hex:021A020103> spirits!

58.original: Welcome back! Were people able to suggest anything for me to cook?

59.original: Oh, you wrote them down! Thank you! Let me see...

60.original: Ah, Voeburt muffins and Kholusian stew! I've made those for my patrons before. I'll need fresh seafood from Stilltide, but that shouldn't be an issue.

61.original: As for a dish that people in Eulmore haven't had before─what do you think? Have you come upon anything in your travels outside the city that people might enjoy?

63.original: Nothing is so comforting as one of the Mol's buuz on a chill evening.

64.original: Perhaps a relaxing cup of herbal tea to pair with the meal?

65.original: Basilisk stew has been known to increase morale.

66.original: Dough with seafood <hex:021A020203>inside<hex:021A020103> of it? That does sound intriguing. Salty shellfish and tender stewed catfish, together in a hearty bun... Yes, I can picture it.

67.original: Yes, that does sound pleasant. We can't focus solely on the food, after all. I haven't the slightest idea what an “Ishgard” is, but I'd certainly be willing to try brewing tea with lily bulbs.

68.original: A sergeant who offered homemade stew to his troops, warming their hearts and lifting their spirits? Oh, I love a dish with a story to tell!

69.original: I'll prepare each of these with the care they deserve, and hopefully my fellow Eulmorans will find some solace in sharing a warm meal.

70.original: I'm off to fetch ingredients, but before I go─here's a little something that I prepared for you, as thanks. I hope it suits your tastes!
